description: Calendar of scheduled crypto token unlocks in the next N days (up to 60), each rated strong / medium / small by size relative to circulating supply. Use for questions like 'which token unlocks are coming this week', 'biggest unlocks in November', 'strong unlocks with perpetual futures'. Data refreshes hourly (data_updated_utc in the result). Results are cut to 'limit' (default 30): 'matched' says how many fit the filters. detail=brief returns one compact row per unlock (use it for wide windows or large limits); detail=full (default) adds recipients, market data and source checks. An unlock with disputed=true has a different amount or date in the project's own documents (dispute_summary gives both versions): report both, never only the calendar number; an unlock without the flag is not necessarily confirmed, most are simply unchecked. The calendar holds 60 days: a larger days value is cut to 60 and limits_note says so. Unknown parameters and wrong enum values return an error. Schedules are compiled from CoinMarketCap and DefiLlama. The futures filter covers KuCoin and Binance USDT perpetuals only. For one coin use get_token_unlocks; for several coins use check_portfolio; for the list of disputed unlocks use get_disputed_unlocks; for what the rating means and past results use get_method_and_track_record; for coverage and sources use get_dataset_info. lang=ru returns Russian page links.

detail.description: brief = compact rows (symbol, date, strength, share, value, futures, dispute flag, page); full = all fields.

sort.description: date = soonest first; size = largest share of circulating supply first.
